'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
